faculty.name: John Anderson
faculty.summary: Studies the structure of higher-level cognition, particularly mathematical problem solving, using cognitive architectures like ACT-R and brain imaging data.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究高级认知结构，特别是数学问题解决，使用认知架构ACT-R和脑成像数据。

faculty.name: Jessica Cantlon
faculty.summary: Studies the origins of quantitative reasoning in human adults, children, and non-human primates using behavioral and neuroimaging methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类成人、儿童和非人灵长类动物的数量推理起源，使用行为和神经成像方法。

faculty.name: Chante Cox-Boyd
faculty.summary: Studies social cognition, focusing on how individuals make social judgments and the impact of these judgments on intergroup relations and stereotypes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会认知，关注个体如何进行社会判断以及这些判断对群体关系和刻板印象的影响。

faculty.name: David Creswell
faculty.summary: Studies how mindfulness meditation and self-affirmation reduce stress and improve health outcomes through neuroimaging and intervention trials.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究正念冥想和自我肯定如何通过神经成像和干预试验减轻压力和改善健康结果。

faculty.name: Kasey Creswell
faculty.summary: Studies the mechanisms of addiction, focusing on cigarette craving and alcohol use, using experimental methodologies and longitudinal designs.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成瘾机制，特别是吸烟渴望和酒精使用，采用实验方法和纵向设计。

faculty.name: Janine Dutcher
faculty.summary: Studies how positive interventions like self-affirmation and mindfulness meditation reduce stress and improve physical health using neuroimaging and psychoneuroimmunology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究积极干预措施（如自我肯定和正念冥想）如何减少压力并改善身体健康，使用神经成像和神经免疫学方法。

faculty.name: Jenelle Feather
faculty.summary: Studies the neural activity patterns underlying perception and cognition using computational modeling, behavioral observations, and brain measurements in auditory and visual perception.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究知觉和认知背后的神经活动模式，使用计算建模、行为观察和脑部测量方法，涉及听觉和视觉知觉。

faculty.name: Brooke Feeney
faculty.summary: Studies how close relationships and specific social behaviors impact human thriving, using video-recording and coding of interactions and physiological assessments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究亲密关系和社会行为如何影响人类繁荣，使用录像和编码互动以及生理评估的方法。

faculty.name: Susanne Ferber
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and neural mechanisms of perception awareness using fMRI and EEG, and investigates cognitive impairments in neurological patients.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究知觉意识的认知和神经机制，使用fMRI和EEG，并研究神经病患者的认知障碍。

faculty.name: Anna Fisher
faculty.summary: Studies how young children learn and generalize knowledge, focusing on inductive reasoning and selective sustained attention.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童如何学习和进行归纳推理，重点关注选择性持续注意和归纳学习。

faculty.name: Vicki Helgeson
faculty.summary: Studies how people adjust to chronic illnesses like diabetes, focusing on psychological and physical well-being, and the role of social support and gender-related traits.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究慢性疾病（如糖尿病）对人们心理和生理健康的适应，关注社会支持和性别相关特质的作用。

faculty.name: Laurie Heller
faculty.summary: Studies how humans use sound to understand environmental events, using perceptual experiments and brain imaging to explore sound recognition and localization.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类如何利用声音理解环境事件，使用知觉实验和脑成像探索声音识别和定位。

faculty.name: Marcel Just
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of human thought using fMRI, focusing on language comprehension, working memory, and social cognition.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）研究人类思维的神经基础，重点关注语言理解、工作记忆和社会认知。

faculty.name: Roberta Klatzky
faculty.summary: Studies perception, spatial thinking, and action across multiple modalities in real and virtual environments, with applications in tele-manipulation and navigation aids.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究知觉、空间思维和动作在多种模态下的表现及其在真实和虚拟环境中的应用，涉及远程操作和导航辅助。

faculty.name: Ken Koedinger
faculty.summary: Studies how students learn through computational models and educational technologies, improving student achievement in mathematics, science, and language.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学生通过计算模型和教育技术学习的方式，提高他们在数学、科学和语言方面的学业成就。

faculty.name: Phoebe Lam
faculty.summary: Studies how early-life stress shapes development across the lifespan and identifies factors that mitigate its negative health effects.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期生活压力如何影响一生的发展，并识别减轻其负面影响的因素。

faculty.name: Marsha Lovett
faculty.summary: Studies how learning works in college-level courses and develops educational technologies to improve student learning and metacognition.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大学课程中的学习过程，并开发教育技术以提高学生的学习和元认知能力。

faculty.name: Brian MacWhinney
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn language through competitive processes and perspective-taking, using neural network models and brain imaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童通过竞争过程和视角转换学习语言，使用神经网络模型和脑成像技术。

faculty.name: Brad Mahon
faculty.summary: Studies how object concepts are represented and organized in the brain, using patients with brain injuries to understand mechanisms of perception and action.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究物体概念在大脑中的表征和组织，通过脑损伤患者了解感知和动作的基本机制。

faculty.name: Kody Manke-Miller
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of social identity and stereotype threat on academic performance and wellbeing, using lab and field studies and interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会身份和刻板印象威胁对学生表现和幸福感的影响，使用实验室和实地研究以及干预措施。

faculty.name: David Plaut
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processing in vision, reading, and language using computational modeling and empirical studies, with a focus on cognitive impairments and development.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用计算建模和实证研究探讨视觉、阅读和语言的认知处理，重点关注认知障碍和发育。

faculty.name: David Rakison
faculty.summary: Studies how infants develop concepts of objects and actions, using behavioral methods and computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何发展对物体和动作的概念，使用行为方法和计算模型。

faculty.name: Barbara Shinn-Cunningham
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain processes and attends to sounds, using behavioral, neuroimaging, and computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理和关注声音，使用行为、神经成像和计算方法。

faculty.name: Erik Thiessen
faculty.summary: Studies how infants learn language and other information from statistical patterns in their environment, using experiments with infants.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何从环境中的统计模式中学习语言和其他信息，使用婴儿实验方法。

faculty.name: Michael Trujillo
faculty.summary: Studies the social and health consequences of stigma, particularly among LGBTQ and minority populations, using experimental and longitudinal methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究污名的社会和健康后果，特别是对LGBTQ和少数群体的影响，使用实验和纵向方法。

faculty.name: Jonathan Tsay
faculty.summary: Studies how humans learn and master movements using computational modeling, psychophysics, and neuropsychology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类如何通过计算建模、心理物理学和神经心理学掌握动作技巧。

faculty.name: Timothy Verstynen
faculty.summary: Studies how we plan actions, the neural mechanisms of stopping actions, and the dynamics of skill learning using psychophysics, computational modeling, and brain imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动作计划、停止动作的神经机制以及技能学习的动力学，使用心理物理学、计算建模和脑成像技术。

faculty.name: David Badre
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive control and decision-making processes using neuroimaging and computational models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知控制和决策过程，使用神经成像和计算模型。

faculty.name: Alison Barth
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuits and computational methods to understand learning and memory processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经回路和计算方法以理解学习与记忆过程。

faculty.name: Drew Beauchamp
faculty.summary: Develops and applies neurotechnology to study neural circuits and motor control, estimating upstream signaling in the spinal cord and brain.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和应用神经技术研究神经回路和运动控制，估计脊髓和大脑中的上游信号传导。

faculty.name: Maysam Chamanzar
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory using computational models and brain imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用计算模型和脑成像技术。

faculty.name: Steve Chase
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory, using brain-computer interfaces and neural prosthetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用脑-机接口和神经假体技术。

faculty.name: Tzahi Cohen-Karni
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of memory and learning using computational models and brain imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆和学习的神经机制，使用计算模型和脑成像技术。

faculty.name: Gary Fedder
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of perception and action, using computational models and robotics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究知觉和动作的神经机制，使用计算模型和机器人技术。

faculty.name: Christopher Genovese
faculty.summary: Studies statistical methods for analyzing brain imaging data, focusing on cognitive processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究统计方法分析脑成像数据，专注于认知过程。

faculty.name: Aryn Gittis
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuits and learning & memory using computational and molecular methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经回路和学习记忆，使用计算和分子方法。

faculty.name: Darcy Griffin
faculty.summary: Studies skilled voluntary movements and signaling through the corticomotoneuronal system.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究技能性自愿运动和皮层-运动神经元系统的信号传递。

faculty.name: Pulkit Grover
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory using computational models and brain imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用计算模型和脑成像技术。

faculty.name: Bin He
faculty.summary: Studies brain-computer interfaces and neural signal processing, using EEG and machine learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑机接口和神经信号处理，使用EEG和机器学习方法。

faculty.name: Martial Hebert
faculty.summary: Develops computational models of perception and action, using machine learning and robotics.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发感知与行动的计算模型，使用机器学习和机器人技术。

faculty.name: Kate Hong
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuits and systems neuroscience using computational and physiological methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经回路和系统神经科学，使用计算和生理学方法。

faculty.name: Jana Kainerstorfer
faculty.summary: Studies brain-computer interfaces and neural signal processing, focusing on decoding neural activity to improve human-computer interaction.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑-机接口和神经信号处理，侧重于解码神经活动以改善人机交互。

faculty.name: Robert Kass
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of decision-making and perception using statistical models and computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究决策和知觉的神经机制，使用统计模型和计算方法。

faculty.name: Tai Sing Lee
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuits and computational methods in learning and memory, developing physiological and anatomical methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经回路和计算方法在学习与记忆中的作用，开发生理和解剖学方法。

faculty.name: Tom Mitchell
faculty.summary: Studies machine learning and computational biology, integrating computer science and neuroscience.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究机器学习和计算生物学，结合计算机科学和神经科学。

faculty.name: Linda Moya
faculty.summary: Studies social decision-making and neural basis of cognition using interdisciplinary approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会决策和认知的神经基础，采用跨学科方法。

faculty.name: Burak Ozdoganlar
faculty.summary: Studies biomechanics of neural tissue, using mechanical engineering principles to understand brain function and injury.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经组织的生物力学，运用机械工程原理理解大脑功能和损伤。

faculty.name: Rahul Panat
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

faculty.name: Andreas Pfenning
faculty.summary: Studies computational models of neural systems to understand motor control and language processing.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究计算模型以理解运动控制和语言处理的神经系统。

faculty.name: Xaq Pitkow
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain processes information and makes decisions, using computational models and neural recordings.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理信息和做出决策，使用计算模型和神经记录方法。

faculty.name: Richard Randall
faculty.summary: Studies music perception and cognition, exploring how musical structures are processed in the brain.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究音乐知觉与认知，探索音乐结构在大脑中的处理机制。

faculty.name: Cosma Shalizi
faculty.summary: Studies statistical models and machine learning algorithms to understand complex systems in neuroscience.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究统计模型和机器学习算法以理解神经科学中的复杂系统。

faculty.name: Aarti Singh
faculty.summary: Develops machine learning algorithms to analyze neural data, improving our understanding of brain function.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发机器学习算法分析神经数据，提高对大脑功能的理解。

faculty.name: Matthew Smith
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of cognition using advanced imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用高级成像技术研究认知的神经基础。

faculty.name: Mike Tarr
faculty.summary: Studies visual perception and object recognition, using neuroimaging and behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和物体识别，使用神经成像和行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Valerie Ventura
faculty.summary: Analyzes statistical methods in neuroscience research.
faculty.summary_zh: 分析神经科学研究中的统计方法。

faculty.name: Saurabh Vyas
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory using computational models and electrophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的神经机制，使用计算模型和电生理学方法。

faculty.name: Doug Weber
faculty.summary: Studies motor control and sensation & perception using computational and mathematical methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究运动控制和感觉知觉，使用计算和数学方法。

faculty.name: Sossena Wood
faculty.summary: Studies learning and memory using behavioral methods and non-invasive brain monitoring techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用行为方法和非侵入性脑部监测技术研究学习与记忆。

faculty.name: Eric Yttri
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuits and learning & memory using computational and systems neuroscience methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经回路和学习记忆，使用计算和系统神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Byron Yu
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of decision-making and motor control using computational models and neural recordings.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究决策和运动控制的神经机制，使用计算模型和神经记录方法。

faculty.name: Yongxin Zhao
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory in rodents using behavioral tasks and electrophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物学习和记忆的神经机制，使用行为任务和电生理学方法。
